30. There may be an option for pregnant women, new mothers and those who are breastfeeding
to give evidence by video. This may, however, not be suitable if there is no one to assist with
childcare and the child is in the same room, which may represent an inappropriate
distraction.
Menopause

31. Despite increased publicity over the last couple of years, the menopause often remains a
taboo subject in the workplace. A survey conducted by the Women and Equalities
Committee in September 2021 found that most women experience menopause symptoms
which also affect them negatively at work. However, most women do not tell anyone at work
or seek adjustments, out of concerns for privacy and worrying about the reaction of others.
Many workplaces do not have any policies and women do not always know how to seek
support.
